label: late original-phase steps (t=4-7) in b-initial sequences, weak diffuse token conjunction
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.02% of steps). 90% of mass is in the original phase at t=4-7 (peak t=5), with small spillover onto <DEL> and the first copy step; it never fires at t<3 or after recall_idx 1. Strongly enriched when the first token is b (16x, 56% of mass) or k (6x), when the previous token is c (12x), and for certain current tokens (e,o,k,v,q,g,h,t,1). The top activations look like b ... c [x] with c at position 4. However, no conjunction of these factors recovers it: the best predicate (t 4-7, enriched current and previous token sets, first token b) gets dev F1 0.16 (precision 0.11, recall 0.29). Activations are spread over many token combinations, which suggests a distributed hidden-state direction rather than a describable rule. It does not fire on the copy phase beyond the first output.
